name: Thief's Folly
description: A graveyard for prospectors, with tombs from dozens of planes.

description_citations.text: "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the artifact is one of six keys, Akul holds the other five in a medallion, and a map to Tarnation is buried in Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: Akul has the other five. He wears them in a medallion around his neck

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko sends Gisa and Geralf to retrieve the map from Thief's Folly.
timeline.quote: "Are the two of you up for a little side mission?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 4: Finding Tarnation" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The siblings reach Thief's Folly and find it a patchwork of tombs from many planes.
timeline.quote: The architecture of the tombs and design of the grave markers were a patchwork amalgam of dozens of planes

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf realizes the grave sigils are an incantation just as Gisa's whistling triggers a trap, and a giant corpsipede erupts.
timeline.quote: what looked like a centipede made from hundreds of bodies fused together

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella Lee, visiting Lucy Bluff's grave, hears the siblings arguing and meets them.
timeline.quote: Stella stepped around a crypt, and found herself looking at two pale, dark-haired people in tattered clothing.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The corpsipede attacks and all three flee to the necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: "Run," said the man, grabbing the woman by the arm and charging straight toward Stella.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella gives Geralf a bottle of angel's blood and lamp oil for free, as she has friends buried in the graveyard.
timeline.quote: "Then it's on the house." Stella tossed him the bottle

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf uses the angel's blood to stitch a construct from Gisa's griffin to fight the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Wild laughter rose in the distance, followed by Geralf walking back into view, leading a horrifying construct behind him.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa whistles to take back her stolen magic from the corpsipede, shrinking it.
timeline.quote: "There," she said. "I've taken back what's mine."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa hums to track the foreign magic and leads them to a sealed Innistradi crypt, which Stella opens with her whip.
timeline.quote: When it struck the padlock, the shackle popped open and the lock fell away

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa finds and destroys a beating heart and a centipede in a canopic jar, collapsing the corpsipede.
timeline.quote: Gisa straightened and stomped on the centipede, grinding it under her toe.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Geralf takes the map from the sarcophagus and the group parts ways with Stella.
timeline.quote: reached inside the sarcophagus, rooting around until he came up with a map.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Stella lets the siblings go, and they ride away still bickering.
timeline.quote: "I suppose there's no captures between friends."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | A Pleasant Family Outing" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa triggers a trap in Thief's Folly, and with Stella Lee's help she and Geralf disable the zombie abomination and secure the map.
timeline.quote: Gisa accidentally triggered a trap and unleashed a zombie abomination that chased after the siblings.

citation.work: Gisa Cecani
citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stella visits Lucy Bluff's grave at Thief's Folly and helps Gisa and Geralf Cecani defeat a zombie centipede so the grave is not disturbed.
timeline.quote: Stella helped the siblings defeat the zombie so Lucy's grave wouldn't be disturbed.

citation.work: Stella Lee
citation.text: "Stella Lee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
